## Read first
- The local Oracle forecast/MCP service stays read-only; a separately enabled TradingView worker can submit Coinbase spot orders or GUM ZEC perpetual Actions. Dry-run remains the default. [src: oracle/README.md#oracle-023; docs/JUPITER-ZEC-WEBHOOK.md]
- GUM application funding, perps collateral deposits and locally verified order Actions are separate boundaries. The order signer does not verify an opaque funding transaction. [src: docs/JUPITER-ZEC-WEBHOOK.md#capital-and-account-requirements; oracle/gum_orders.py]
- The owner selected ZEC/USDC with 2x leverage and 75 percent of available USDC as collateral; this policy does not establish a profitable strategy. [src: docs/JUPITER-ZEC-WEBHOOK.md#capital-and-account-requirements]
- Eleven components separate research, observations, paper ownership, hosted accounts, UI and optional execution. [src: README.md#solmargintrader; docs/COMPONENTS.md]
- Source packages are manager 0.7.3, ecosystem 0.4.10, research runtime 0.4.1, Oracle 0.2.4 and canonical backtester 0.2.1; website source is 0.3.0. Source versions do not prove installation or deployment. [src: botmanager/pyproject.toml; ecosystem/pyproject.toml; soltui/pyproject.toml; oracle/pyproject.toml; backtester/pyproject.toml; website/package.json]
- Website 0.3.0 provides wallet accounts, research, inactive paper definitions and Starter/Advanced/Unlimited policies: $9.99 for 3 slots/10 backtests per UTC day, $29.99 for 10 slots/unlimited backtests and $49.99 without count caps. First-eligible trials last 7 days; Checkout defaults closed until launch gates qualify. [src: website/README.md#membership-policies-website-030; website/src/worker.js]
- Hosted MCP 2025-11-25 JSON POST uses OAuth PKCE S256 and resource-bound bearer grants. Account status and intents always belong to that bearer wallet; cookies and caller-supplied wallet/account/signer overrides cannot replace it. [src: website/src/oauth.js; website/src/mcp.js; website/docs/MCP-DESIGN.md]
- Trading consent signs one finite agent policy with venues/assets, per-trade/cumulative USD caps and expiry. It requires no per-trade wallet prompt; Settings revocation is immediate. Login signatures grant no spend authority. [src: website/README.md#agent-access-and-preauthorized-trading; website/public/agent-access.js; website/src/oauth.js]
- Trade writes atomically fence current known-plan entitlement and wallet policy. Unknown submissions retain budget and cannot auto-retry; deletion cannot erase unresolved intents. No USER_TRADE_EXECUTOR is provisioned, LIVE_EXECUTION_ENABLED defaults false, and successful adapter fixtures are mocks. Real delegation/signing/reconciliation/order acceptance remain unqualified. [src: website/src/trades.js; website/src/worker.js; website/wrangler.jsonc; website/docs/MCP-DESIGN.md]
- Backtester and research stay offline during simulation; explicit fetching is a separate operation. [src: CLAUDE.md#non-negotiables--backtester]
- Extension defaults stay dry-run and disarmed; its central risk rails fail closed. [src: CLAUDE.md#non-negotiables--extension]
- SolTUI has a separately armed manual Coinbase path; it is not merely a read-only display. [src: CLAUDE.md#what-this-is]
- The manual Jupiter V2 path supplies previews; submission is blocked pending independent economic verification. [src: CLAUDE.md#known-unverified-areas]
- Liquidity is archived as of 2026-11-08; its service remains disabled with its kill switch set. [src: CLAUDE.md#live-on-chain-actions-owners-standing-authorization]
- The manager suite reuses one Supervisor and does not create a second recorder, optimizer, signer or research authority. [src: docs/bot-manager-managed-suite.md#install-and-control-persistent-availability]
- Compact collector commands are solbot health-check, solbot metrics and solbot component-alerts. [src: docs/bot-manager-managed-suite.md#machine-health-and-alert-collection]
- UI status is inert; ui open explicitly starts availability if needed and opens only a verified local URL. [src: docs/bot-manager-managed-suite.md#find-and-open-the-interface]
- The complete manager command order is in solbot --help and structured solbot help. [src: docs/bot-manager-managed-suite.md#solbot-managed-availability-ui-access-and-platform-setup]
- The existing packaged ecosystem wiki is the maintained project navigation; source guides remain authoritative for their scope. [src: docs/ECOSYSTEM-WIKI.md#project-navigation]
- Wiki source changes require a deterministic rebuild and integrity check; generated bundles are not hand-edited. [src: docs/ECOSYSTEM-WIKI.md#maintenance-ownership]
- macOS availability starts at user login after reboot; KeepAlive crash recovery is distinct from a physical reboot test. [src: docs/bot-manager-managed-suite.md#install-and-control-persistent-availability]
- Linux uses a systemd user service; linger is a separate host policy. Windows needs WSL2 and a separate Windows-Chrome native bridge. [src: docs/bot-manager-managed-suite.md#windows-through-wsl2]
- Keep INDEX_NO_AUTO=1 for read-only retrieval and tests; semantic indexing is a separate explicit operation. [src: CLAUDE.md#retrieval-before-exploration]
- Workflow record versions are separate from component package versions. [src: CLAUDE.md#workflow-records]
- Python is 3.13 and CI Node is pinned by .nvmrc; extension has no npm runtime dependencies. [src: CLAUDE.md#house-style; .nvmrc]
- A cached research ranking is not a new corrected-engine experiment; rerun before treating it as current performance. [src: README.md#quick-start]
